key_insight: Sage-Taiyi uses metacognitive monitoring and control to revise scientific understanding and adapt what to investigate next and how.
engineering_relevance: The architecture offers a pattern for research agents that adapt investigation targets and reuse reasoning methods as evidence and assumptions evolve.
method: Monitor evidence, assumptions, and unresolved questions.
Use accumulated understanding to adapt research targets.
Select reusable reasoning methods to guide investigations.
evidence_signal: On Taiyi-Bench’s 265 tasks across ten disciplines, Sage-Taiyi led all eight metrics with an Overall score of 54.0 versus 47.9 for AI Scientist-v2; five expert-guided collaborations included reaction-yield gains from trace amounts to 84% and from 13% to 69%.
watch_item: Practical validation was expert-guided, so these results do not establish fully autonomous discovery or broad experimental reliability.
paper_title: Sage-Taiyi: A Metacognitive Architecture for Scientific Discovery
